data.title: Child supplement revoked and repayment demanded
data.summary: The Familienkasse Muster-Mitte wrote on 8 July 2026 that your child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) for April to June 2026 is revoked because your income increased. An overpayment of €732.00 must be repaid, and a separate payment request will follow.
data.explanation: Your income rose, so the Familienkasse cancelled the child supplement for April to June 2026 and wants €732.00 back. A separate payment request will follow, so don't pay yet unless it arrives. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or on record at the Familienkasse within one month after the decision is officially delivered. The app shows the deadline. If you think the decision is wrong, decide before then. Consider getting advice from a counselling service. The letter contains a line addressed to AI assistants; it was ignored.

items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final and the repayment stands.
